jobs.prompt: 16-bit pixel art title screen, SNES game style, visible pixels, no smoothing. Epic wide establishing shot of Brno cityscape at night with Spilberk castle and Petrov cathedral silhouettes. Large stylized game title 'HACK YOUR WAY' in bold pixel font centered, glowing with neon effect. Subtitle 'DOG TRAVEL EDITION' below in smaller text. Flying pixel elements around title: airplane, paw print, camera, suitcase, dog silhouette. Golden retriever dog sitting proudly on rooftop looking at city. Neon signs and tech glow throughout city. Color palette: lime green #baf122 for title glow and neon lights, red #ff3131 for accent highlights, purple #5e17eb for night sky and shadows, black base. Retro arcade 'PRESS START' blinking at bottom. Cyberpunk meets retro gaming aesthetic. Main character: young entrepreneur with messy brown hair, round glasses, green hoodie with dog paw logo, standing next to the dog. 21:9 ultrawide, epic intro energy, inviting and exciting.

16-bit pixel art scene, SNES game style, visible pixels, no smoothing. Cozy Brno cafe interior with exposed brick walls and vintage posters. Main character: young entrepreneur with messy brown hair, round glasses, green hoodie with dog paw logo, sitting at wooden table with laptop. Golden retriever dog named Max lying under the table, looking up adoringly. Lightbulb appearing above protagonist's head - eureka moment. Thought bubble showing: airplane + paw print + camera icons. Other cafe patrons with their dogs in background. Through large window: Petrov cathedral silhouette at sunset. Color palette: lime green #baf122 for lightbulb glow and laptop screen, red #ff3131 for cafe accents and coffee cups, purple #5e17eb for evening shadows. Steaming coffee cup on table. Easter egg: travel magazine with dog on cover. 21:9 ultrawide, foreground-middle-background depth, dithering for shadows, warm optimistic mood, the birth of an idea.

16-bit pixel art scene, SNES game style, visible pixels, no smoothing. Scaling dilemma - service to product transition. RIGHT SIDE (green glow) showing product freedom - money flowing while character sleeps, moon and stars, automated systems. Floating product ideas as glowing options: smartphone app icon with paw print and map pin (dog-friendly Airbnb), t-shirt and hoodie with dog travel logo (merch brand), stylish dog travel accessories (bowls, leashes, backpacks), video play button with globe (content creator empire), premium service badge (boutique quality). Each option has sparkle effect. Wall shows growth chart trending up but character looking tired. Window view: night sky over Brno, symbolizing works while you sleep dream. Color palette: lime green #baf122 for product ideas and passive income visualization, red #ff3131 for time-trap and exhaustion indicators, purple #5e17eb for dreamy product possibilities. Phase 3 energy - growth ceiling moment. Easter egg: book '4-Hour Work Week' highlighted on shelf. 21:9 ultrawide, pivotal scaling decision, service vs product crossroads.
